entryPointCandidates.name: README.md
entryPointCandidates.summary: Primary project documentation for eruption-forecast covering features, package architecture, the CalculateTremor-to-ExplanationModel pipeline, SDS/FDSN data sources, quick start, common patterns (scenario sweeps, cache reuse, config replay), supported classifiers, output directory layout, and development workflow.

entryPointCandidates.name: main.py
entryPointCandidates.summary: Reference end-to-end pipeline script that chains ForecastModel calculate, train, predict, evaluate and explain over a list of known eruption dates, wrapped with timer and Telegram notify decorators.

entryPointCandidates.name: __init__.py
entryPointCandidates.summary: Package root that sets up logging and re-exports the public API: tremor calculation, label builders, feature builders, stage models, ForecastModel, decorators and TelegramNotification.

entryPointCandidates.name: forecast-scenario.py
entryPointCandidates.summary: End-to-end script that defines a list of Scenario dicts and runs a ForecastModelScenario sweep: tremor calculation once, then shared training/prediction/evaluation/explanation settings looped over each train/forecast date split.

entryPointCandidates.name: __init__.py
entryPointCandidates.summary: Package barrel for the dataclass subpackage, re-exporting StationData, SHAP explanation payloads and classifier-ensemble summary dataclasses.

documentation.name: API-Reference.md
documentation.summary: Exhaustive API reference for the public classes: ForecastModel, the four stage models, ensembles, SHAP dataclasses, StationData, CalculateTremor, label/feature builders, FeatureSelector, FeatureCountSweep and SeedEnsemble, with constructor signatures and method tables.

documentation.name: Architecture.md
documentation.summary: Architecture guide covering package layout, pipeline overview, component details, model class relationships (BaseModel hierarchy and ensemble stack), end-to-end data flow and the utility-module catalog.

documentation.name: Configuration.md
documentation.summary: Explains the ForecastConfig lifecycle and YAML schema, standalone per-stage configs, config.example.yaml, Telegram notification setup, logging categories, and where config files land on disk.

documentation.name: Data-Sources.md
documentation.summary: Describes the SeismicDataSource ABC and its SDS (local SeisComP archive) and FDSN (web service with local SDS cache) implementations, compares them, and lists the frequency bands CalculateTremor reads.

documentation.name: Evaluation-Workflow.md
documentation.summary: Guide to EvaluationModel: training-reuse vs prediction-reuse modes, how evaluate() drives MetricsEnsemble, cross-classifier comparison via ClassifierComparator, outputs, cache semantics and standalone use.

documentation.name: Explanation-Workflow.md
documentation.summary: Guide to ExplanationModel and ExplainerEnsemble: the TreeExplainer-only constraint, operating modes, explain()/plot() phases, SHAP dataclass composition, plot inventory, per-eruption waterfall selection, outputs and caching.

documentation.name: Feature-Count-Sweep.md
documentation.summary: Documents the experimental FeatureCountSweep / sweep_feature_count post-hoc recommender for top_n_features, including scoring modes, estimator_mode, picking N*, forecast-mode wiring, outputs and reference API.

documentation.name: Getting-Started.md
documentation.summary: Installation and setup guide covering prerequisites, uv-based install of runtime and dev dependencies, development commands, optional Telegram notification setup and next steps.

documentation.name: Home.md
documentation.summary: Wiki landing page with a research-use-only disclaimer, navigation to all wiki pages, a summary of what the package does, a repository map and key links.

documentation.name: Output-Structure.md
documentation.summary: Full reference of the on-disk output tree per station directory, classifier/CV slug mappings, filename conventions, content-addressed cache layout, scenarios layout and a cheat sheet of where artifacts live.

documentation.name: Pipeline-Walkthrough.md
documentation.summary: Walks through the two end-to-end workflows: the research pipeline in main.py using ForecastModel, and the multi-scenario sweep in forecast-scenario.py using ForecastModelScenario, with guidance on choosing between them.

documentation.name: Prediction-Workflow.md
documentation.summary: Guide to PredictionModel: internal pipeline, accepted trained-model sources, forecast grid labelling, feature extraction and use_features_from scoping, forecast() outputs, caching and standalone use.

documentation.name: Training-Workflow.md
documentation.summary: Guide to TrainingModel: label building, tsfresh feature pipeline and selection, multi-seed classifier fitting, classifier catalog, CV strategies, caching, outputs, standalone use and the experimental top_n_features sweep.

documentation.name: Usage.md
documentation.summary: Usage guide with a quick start, stage cheat sheet, annotated main.py example, how to access per-stage results, and common pipeline variants.

documentation.name: Visualization.md
documentation.summary: Catalog of plotting utilities for tremor, features, forecasts, evaluation curves, label distributions and SHAP plots, plus the Nature-style default styling.

documentation.name: README.md
documentation.summary: Primary project documentation for eruption-forecast covering features, package architecture, the CalculateTremor-to-ExplanationModel pipeline, SDS/FDSN data sources, quick start, common patterns (scenario sweeps, cache reuse, config replay), supported classifiers, output directory layout, and development workflow.

list.name: Entry Points
list.description: End-user pipeline scripts (main.py, forecast-scenario.py) and the package __init__ that re-exports the public ForecastModel/TremorData/LabelData API.

list.name: Pipeline Orchestration & Stage Models
list.description: ForecastModel and ForecastModelScenario orchestrators plus the BaseModel-derived Training, Prediction, Evaluation and Explanation stage models with content-addressed caching, classifier definitions and cross-classifier comparison.

list.name: Ensemble Engine
list.description: Multi-seed SeedEnsemble and ClassifierEnsemble estimators plus the MetricsEnsemble and ExplainerEnsemble engines that compute per-seed metrics and SHAP explanations.

list.name: Seismic Ingestion & Tremor
list.description: SDS and FDSN seismic data sources and the CalculateTremor pipeline that computes RSAM, DSAR and Shannon entropy across frequency bands into tremor CSVs.

list.name: Labelling & Feature Engineering
list.description: Sliding-window eruption label builders and the tsfresh-based tremor matrix, feature extraction, feature selection and feature-count sweep components.

list.name: Configuration & Data Types
list.description: ForecastConfig and per-stage config dataclasses, shared constants, and immutable data containers such as StationData, BaseDataContainer and SHAP/ensemble summary payloads.

list.name: Visualization
list.description: Matplotlib/SHAP plotting modules for tremor, labels, features, forecasts, evaluation metrics and explanations with shared styling.

list.name: Utilities & Cross-Cutting Services
list.description: Focused helper modules (arrays, windows, dates, ML, validation, paths, dataframes, features, formatting) plus Loguru logging, timer/notify decorators and Telegram notification.

list.name: Documentation
list.description: README and the 15-page GitHub wiki covering getting started, pipeline workflows, configuration, output structure, architecture and API reference.

file:src/eruption_forecast/dataclass/__i.name: __init__.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/dataclass/__i.summary: Package barrel for the dataclass subpackage, re-exporting StationData, SHAP explanation payloads and classifier-ensemble summary dataclasses.

file:src/eruption_forecast/dataclass/cla.name: classifier_ensemble_summary.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/dataclass/cla.summary: Defines frozen dataclasses (ProbabilityPick, SeedSummary, EruptionWindow, ClassifierEnsembleSummary) that describe per-eruption probability summaries across a classifier ensemble's seeds.

file:src/eruption_forecast/dataclass/cla.name: classifier_explanation.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/dataclass/cla.summary: Defines slotted dataclasses SeedExplanation and ClassifierExplanation holding per-seed and per-classifier SHAP explanation payloads.

file:src/eruption_forecast/dataclass/sta.name: station_data.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/dataclass/sta.summary: Defines the StationData dataclass, an uppercased seismic station identity (network, station, location, channel) with derived nslc/nslct strings.

file:src/eruption_forecast/ensemble/__in.name: __init__.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/ensemble/__in.summary: Package barrel for the ensemble subpackage re-exporting SeedEnsemble and ClassifierEnsemble; other ensemble classes are deliberately not re-exported to avoid import cycles.

file:src/eruption_forecast/ensemble/base.name: base_ensemble.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/ensemble/base.summary: Provides the BaseEnsemble mixin implementing joblib-based save/load persistence shared by the ensemble classes.

file:src/eruption_forecast/ensemble/clas.name: classifier_ensemble.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/ensemble/clas.summary: Implements ClassifierEnsemble, a container of per-classifier SeedEnsembles with factory loaders (any/json/dict/seed ensembles) and consensus probability, prediction and uncertainty computation.

file:src/eruption_forecast/ensemble/expl.name: explainer_ensemble.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/ensemble/expl.summary: Implements ExplainerEnsemble, the per-seed SHAP TreeExplainer engine that computes ClassifierExplanation payloads in parallel and renders per-seed, aggregate and per-eruption waterfall plots.

file:src/eruption_forecast/ensemble/seed.name: seed_ensemble.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/ensemble/seed.summary: Implements SeedEnsemble, an sklearn-compatible classifier bundling all seed models for one classifier, with registry loaders, probability/uncertainty prediction and Parquet matrix caching.

file:src/eruption_forecast/model/explana.name: explanation_model.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/model/explana.summary: Implements ExplanationModel, the pipeline stage that reuses a TrainingModel or PredictionModel to produce cached per-seed SHAP explanations and plots via ExplainerEnsemble.

file:src/eruption_forecast/plots/explana.name: explanation_plots.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/plots/explana.summary: SHAP visualisation utilities: per-seed waterfall/beeswarm/bar plots, NaN-padded aggregate bar and beeswarm plots across seeds, and per-eruption classifier waterfalls.

file:src/eruption_forecast/utils/array.p.name: array.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/utils/array.p.summary: Numerical array helpers for tremor cleaning (outlier, z-score anomaly, zero masking, NaN filtering, completeness) plus ensemble probability aggregation and per-seed forecast saving.

file:src/eruption_forecast/utils/formatt.name: formatting.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/utils/formatt.summary: String formatting helpers: slugify utilities, tsfresh feature-name shortening and humanising using frequency-band aliases, and classifier display labels.

file:src/eruption_forecast/__init__.py.name: __init__.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/__init__.py.summary: Package root that sets up logging and re-exports the public API: tremor calculation, label builders, feature builders, stage models, ForecastModel, decorators and TelegramNotification.

file:src/eruption_forecast/data_containe.name: data_container.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/data_containe.summary: Defines BaseDataContainer, the abstract base for TremorData and LabelData providing cached filename/basename/filetype properties and abstract date/data accessors.

file:src/eruption_forecast/decorators/__.name: __init__.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/decorators/__.summary: Barrel for the decorators subpackage, re-exporting the notify and timer decorators.

file:src/eruption_forecast/decorators/no.name: notify.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/decorators/no.summary: Implements the @notify decorator that times a wrapped task and sends MarkdownV2-formatted Telegram success or error messages including hostname, elapsed time and exception details.

file:src/eruption_forecast/decorators/ti.name: timer.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/decorators/ti.summary: Provides the @timer decorator that logs elapsed wall-clock time of a function and optionally forwards it to Telegram.

file:src/eruption_forecast/label/constan.name: constants.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/label/constan.summary: Constants for label filename prefixes, minimum date range, valid window step units, date format and an example label filename used in validation messages.

file:src/eruption_forecast/label/label_b.name: label_builder.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/label/label_b.summary: Implements LabelBuilder, which builds sliding-window binary eruption labels over a date range using day_to_forecast look-ahead, validates inputs, saves label CSVs and config snapshots, and plots label distributions.

file:src/eruption_forecast/label/label_d.name: label_data.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/label/label_d.summary: Defines LabelData, a BaseDataContainer wrapper around a label CSV that parses window/forecast parameters from the filename and exposes cached dates, DataFrame and validation.

file:src/eruption_forecast/model/forecas.name: forecast_model_scenario.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/model/forecas.summary: Defines the Scenario TypedDict and ForecastModelScenario, which runs tremor calculation once then loops train, predict, evaluate and explain over multiple scenarios with shared stage settings, a scenarios.json manifest and Telegram delivery of forecast plots.

file:src/eruption_forecast/notification/.name: __init__.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/notification/.summary: Barrel for the notification subpackage, re-exporting TelegramNotification.

file:src/eruption_forecast/notification/.name: telegram.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/notification/.summary: Implements TelegramNotification, a fluent Telegram Bot API client for sending messages, documents, photos and media groups with credentials from arguments or .env, logging and swallowing network failures.

file:src/eruption_forecast/plots/label_p.name: label_plots.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/plots/label_p.summary: Plotting utilities for label class distributions, single and multi-scenario comparisons, with file-loading wrapper variants and TypedDict scenario entry specs.

file:src/eruption_forecast/config/consta.name: constants.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/config/consta.summary: Central module of package-wide constants: default tremor methods, frequency bands, 10-minute window duration and sampling frequency, completeness ratio, bandpass corners, under-sampling ratio and the eruption probability threshold.

file:src/eruption_forecast/sources/__ini.name: __init__.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/sources/__ini.summary: Barrel for the seismic data sources package, re-exporting the SDS archive reader and the FDSN web-service client.

file:src/eruption_forecast/sources/base..name: base.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/sources/base..summary: Defines the SeismicDataSource abstract base class that every waveform source implements via a get(date) method returning an ObsPy Stream.

file:src/eruption_forecast/sources/fdsn..name: fdsn.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/sources/fdsn..summary: FDSN web-service data source that downloads daily waveforms via the ObsPy FDSN client and transparently caches them in a local SDS archive.

file:src/eruption_forecast/sources/sds.p.name: sds.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/sources/sds.p.summary: Reader and writer for local SeisComP Data Structure (SDS) archives: resolves daily miniSEED paths, loads and merges streams, and saves downloaded data.

file:src/eruption_forecast/tremor/__init.name: __init__.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/tremor/__init.summary: Barrel for the tremor package exposing DSAR, RSAM, ShannonEntropy, TremorData and the CalculateTremor orchestrator.

file:src/eruption_forecast/tremor/calcul.name: calculate_tremor.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/tremor/calcul.summary: Core tremor orchestrator that reads seismic data day-by-day from SDS or FDSN, computes RSAM, DSAR and Shannon entropy across frequency bands in parallel, merges daily CSVs and plots results.

file:src/eruption_forecast/tremor/dsar.p.name: dsar.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/tremor/dsar.p.summary: Implements the DSAR calculator computing ratios of windowed mean absolute amplitudes between two consecutive frequency-band filtered streams.

file:src/eruption_forecast/tremor/rsam.p.name: rsam.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/tremor/rsam.p.summary: Implements the RSAM calculator that bandpass-filters a stream and computes windowed amplitude statistics (default mean) per frequency band.

file:src/eruption_forecast/tremor/shanno.name: shannon_entropy.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/tremor/shanno.summary: Implements the ShannonEntropy calculator that filters a broadband stream and computes windowed Gaussian differential entropy as a signal-complexity metric.

file:src/eruption_forecast/utils/window..name: window.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/utils/window..summary: Windowing utilities for seismic traces: window statistics, daily chunking, per-window metric computation with outlier removal and completeness checks, entropy and sliding-window date construction.

file:src/eruption_forecast/features/__in.name: __init__.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/features/__in.summary: Package barrel for the features subpackage that re-exports the experimental FeatureCountSweep class and sweep_feature_count helper.

file:src/eruption_forecast/features/feat.name: feature_count_sweep.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/features/feat.summary: Experimental post-hoc recommender that sweeps top-N feature counts over persisted per-seed training artefacts, scoring each count with cross-validation to recommend an optimal top_n_features value.

file:src/eruption_forecast/features/feat.name: feature_selector.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/features/feat.summary: Single-stage feature selector supporting tsfresh FDR p-value filtering or random-forest permutation importance, exposing an sklearn-style fit/transform API.

file:src/eruption_forecast/label/dynamic.name: dynamic_label_builder.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/label/dynamic.summary: Label builder subclass that constructs per-eruption sliding-window labels in three phases: zero frames per eruption, concatenate and deduplicate, then mark positives.

file:src/eruption_forecast/logger.py.name: logger.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/logger.py.summary: Loguru-based logging wrapper providing console/file handlers, per-category error log routing, and enable/disable/level/directory controls for the package.

file:src/eruption_forecast/model/classif.name: classifier_model.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/model/classif.summary: Defines ClassifierModel, an sklearn-compatible wrapper that builds one of 11 classifier estimators with its hyperparameter grid, CV splitter, and slugified output names.

file:src/eruption_forecast/model/constan.name: constants.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/model/constan.summary: Constants module defining evaluation metric keys, the list of supported classifier codes, and default GridSearchCV hyperparameter grids per classifier.

file:src/eruption_forecast/model/trainin.name: training_model.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/model/trainin.summary: Core training stage model that builds labels, extracts tsfresh features, selects features per seed, and fits multi-seed GridSearchCV classifiers, bundling results into SeedEnsemble/ClassifierEnsemble artefacts with content-addressed caching.

file:src/eruption_forecast/utils/benchma.name: benchmark.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/utils/benchma.summary: Benchmark utility comparing FeatureSelector methods side by side across seeds, measuring selection stability (Jaccard), runtime, and downstream CV scores with plots and CSV outputs.

file:src/eruption_forecast/utils/datafra.name: dataframe.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/utils/datafra.summary: DataFrame helpers for loading label CSVs, datetime-indexed feature matrices, removing tremor anomalies, and computing envelope values.

file:src/eruption_forecast/utils/ml.py.name: ml.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/utils/ml.py.summary: Machine-learning utility module covering resampling, temporal splits, tsfresh significance filtering, classifier factory, grid search, model registry JSON persistence, threshold metrics, and per-eruption ensemble summaries.

file:src/eruption_forecast/features/cons.name: constants.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/features/cons.summary: Defines shared column-name constants (id, datetime, is_erupted), seconds-per-day, and the default set of tsfresh calculators excluded from feature extraction.

file:src/eruption_forecast/features/feat.name: features_builder.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/features/feat.summary: Implements FeaturesBuilder, which runs per-column tsfresh feature extraction over windowed tremor matrices in training or prediction mode, caches Parquet outputs, and merges them into a unified features matrix.

file:src/eruption_forecast/features/trem.name: tremor_matrix_builder.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/features/trem.summary: Implements TremorMatrixBuilder, which slices tremor time-series into label-aligned windows, validates per-window sample counts, and concatenates them into a single id/datetime-indexed matrix (optionally saved per tremor column).

file:src/eruption_forecast/model/base_mo.name: base_model.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/model/base_mo.summary: Abstract base for all stage models (training, prediction, evaluation, explanation) providing tremor loading, date/directory resolution, label and feature building, config saving, and a content-addressable cache with hashed identities and dual-mode save/load.

file:src/eruption_forecast/model/forecas.name: forecast_model.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/model/forecas.summary: Top-level ForecastModel orchestrator chaining calculate, train, predict, evaluate and explain stages, capturing each stage kwargs into a ForecastConfig for save_config/from_config/run replay with cache-aware stage reuse.

file:src/eruption_forecast/model/predict.name: prediction_model.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/model/predict.summary: Implements PredictionModel, which loads a trained ClassifierEnsemble, builds an unlabelled forecast window grid, extracts (or loads) features, computes per-classifier and consensus eruption probabilities, and plots the forecast with cache identity tied to the training hash.

file:src/eruption_forecast/tremor/tremor.name: tremor_data.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/tremor/tremor.summary: Defines TremorData, a BaseDataContainer wrapper around a tremor CSV exposing cached properties for the DataFrame, columns, date range and day count, plus sampling-rate consistency checks.

file:src/eruption_forecast/utils/__init_.name: __init__.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/utils/__init_.summary: Barrel module for the utils package re-exporting label-filename parsing and the core validation guard functions.

file:src/eruption_forecast/utils/date_ut.name: date_utils.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/utils/date_ut.summary: Date helpers for converting values to datetime, normalizing and sorting date lists, parsing label CSV filenames into parameters, and coercing DataFrames to a DatetimeIndex.

file:src/eruption_forecast/utils/feature.name: feature_utils.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/utils/feature.summary: Feature-list utilities for loading curated or aliased feature sets, maintaining ranked top-features CSVs, concatenating per-seed significant features, finding common features, and merging tsfresh features matrices.

file:src/eruption_forecast/utils/validat.name: validation.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/utils/validat.summary: Centralized guard functions validating random states, date ranges, window steps, required DataFrame columns, and time-series sampling consistency.

file:src/eruption_forecast/config/__init.name: __init__.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/config/__init.summary: Package barrel for the config subpackage, re-exporting constants, BaseConfig, LabelConfig, the ForecastConfig family and the standalone per-stage configs (training, prediction, evaluation, explanation).

file:src/eruption_forecast/config/base_c.name: base_config.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/config/base_c.summary: Defines the BaseConfig dataclass mixin providing shared version/saved_at stamping plus dict round-tripping (to_dict, to_init_kwargs, from_dict) for every config dataclass.

file:src/eruption_forecast/config/evalua.name: evaluation_config.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/config/evalua.summary: EvaluationConfig dataclass snapshotting EvaluationModel constructor and evaluate() arguments, with YAML/JSON save and load for per-stage config files.

file:src/eruption_forecast/config/explan.name: explanation_config.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/config/explan.summary: ExplanationConfig dataclass mirroring ExplanationModel settings (SHAP explain/plot options) with YAML/JSON persistence for explanation config files.

file:src/eruption_forecast/config/foreca.name: forecast_config.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/config/foreca.summary: Hierarchical ForecastConfig for the ForecastModel orchestrator: base station settings plus per-stage calculate/train/predict/evaluate/explain sub-configs, serialised to YAML/JSON so pipelines can be replayed via from_config() and run().

file:src/eruption_forecast/config/label_.name: label_config.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/config/label_.summary: LabelConfig dataclass capturing LabelBuilder init arguments (window size/step, day_to_forecast, eruption dates) and saving them as label.config.yaml.

file:src/eruption_forecast/config/predic.name: prediction_config.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/config/predic.summary: PredictionConfig dataclass mirroring PredictionModel constructor parameters with YAML/JSON save/load used by forecast() to write prediction config files.

file:src/eruption_forecast/config/traini.name: training_config.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/config/traini.summary: TrainingConfig dataclass mirroring TrainingModel.__init__ fields and defaults (classifiers, CV, seeds, resampling, features) with YAML/JSON persistence written at the end of fit().

file:src/eruption_forecast/utils/pathuti.name: pathutils.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/utils/pathuti.summary: Filesystem and I/O helpers used throughout the package: output-directory resolution, NSLC directory setup, figure/PDF saving with metadata, generic data saving (CSV/Parquet), and JSON/pickle loading.

file:src/eruption_forecast/ensemble/metr.name: metrics_ensemble.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/ensemble/metr.summary: Per-seed metric engine over a fitted ClassifierEnsemble: computes (n_samples, n_seeds) probability/prediction matrices, persists them as CSV, renders per-seed and aggregate evaluation plots in parallel, and round-trips via joblib.

file:src/eruption_forecast/model/classif.name: classifier_comparator.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/model/classif.summary: Cross-classifier comparison utility that ranks classifiers by per-seed metrics and draws ROC, PR, metric-bar, seed-stability and grid comparison figures from a MetricsEnsemble.

file:src/eruption_forecast/model/evaluat.name: evaluation_model.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/model/evaluat.summary: EvaluationModel pipeline stage that scores a pre-trained ensemble against ground truth in training-reuse or prediction-reuse mode, with content-addressed caching, config snapshots and classifier comparison.

file:src/eruption_forecast/plots/__init_.name: __init__.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/plots/__init_.summary: Barrel module for the plots package that re-exports style helpers and the public tremor, label, feature, forecast and evaluation plotting functions.

file:src/eruption_forecast/plots/evaluat.name: evaluation_plots.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/plots/evaluat.summary: Evaluation plotting library producing per-seed and aggregate threshold, confusion matrix, ROC, PR, G-mean, MCC and feature-importance figures, plus dispatcher-based renderers for parallel workers.

file:src/eruption_forecast/plots/feature.name: feature_plots.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/plots/feature.summary: Feature visualisation module for significant-feature rankings, frequency-band contribution, feature correlations, feature-count curves, cross-run common-feature heatmaps and features-matrix time series.

file:src/eruption_forecast/plots/forecas.name: forecast_plots.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/plots/forecas.summary: Forecast plotting module drawing eruption probability, uncertainty and per-classifier panels over time, with eruption markers and optional training/gap/prediction segment strips.

file:src/eruption_forecast/plots/styles..name: styles.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/plots/styles..summary: Central Nature/Science-style matplotlib configuration: colorblind-safe palettes, rcParams setup, figure context managers, color lookup, spine configuration and journal figure sizing.

file:src/eruption_forecast/plots/tremor_.name: tremor_plots.py
file:src/eruption_forecast/plots/tremor_.summary: Tremor plotting module rendering RSAM/DSAR/entropy time series per column with eruption markers, plus file-based replot and batch replot helpers.
